items.title: KeyCorp, Fifth Third Bancorp, Citizens Financial Group, Walker & Dunlop, and PNC Financial Services Group Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years and Chair Kevin Warsh stressed that inflation risks remain elevated. According to CNBC, the Fed unanimously raised the overnight funds rate by a quarter point to a 3.75%–4% target range and signaled another hike could come this year. items.title: KeyCorp Raises 2026 Revenue Outlook: What's Driving It?

items.title: Winners And Losers Of Q2: KeyCorp (NYSE:KEY) Vs The Rest Of The Regional Banks Stocks
items.summary: Quarterly earnings results are a good time to check in on a company’s progress, especially compared to its peers in the same sector. Today we are looking at KeyCorp (NYSE:KEY) and the best and worst performers in the regional banks industry.

items.title: Will Truist's NII Growth Momentum Continue to Strengthen in 2026?
items.summary: TFC's NII growth is likely to remain positive in 2026, backed by loan and earning-asset growth, but loan spreads and deposit mix could limit momentum.

items.title: Will KeyCorp's Revenue Growth Trend Gain Further Momentum in 2026?
items.summary: KEY's strong NII, lending, and fee income growth support revenue momentum, while investment banking activity adds further growth opportunities.

items.title: KeyCorp taps City National, Fifth Third alum as strategy chief
items.summary: Chris Doll’s “ability to align strategy, financial discipline, and execution will be instrumental as we continue to drive long-term growth,” Key CFO Clark Khayat said.
